sentences.en: Don't forget that wrong conceptions lead to wrong conclusions.
sentences.zh: 别忘了错误的概念会导致错误的结论。

sentences.en: According to Judaism, life begins at birth and not at conception.
sentences.zh: 根据犹太教的观点，生命始于出生而非受精卵形成之时。

sentences.en: The separatists have their own conception of the world.
sentences.zh: 分离主义者对世界的看法与我们不同。

senses.zh: 思想, 观念, 概念构想, 设想怀孕形容词:conceptional
